CI patch set 1: Verified -1 solely from tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_ensures.py::test_mcp_startup_sweeps_before_run on the ubuntu py3.13 shard. That is open bug de95-1594-1056-436e (solid-velour-lynx), an already-root-caused order-dependent flake under pytest-randomly with exactly this signature; py3.11, py3.12 and macos py3.13 were green on the same patch set, and the file passes locally isolated (10 passed) and under xdist -n 4 over tests/interfaces/store/ (436 passed). Provably disjoint: this patch touches only llm/failure.py (comment), llm/plan_review/sizing.py (one predicate) and one new unit test; nothing on the mcp_server / config / _store.ensures path. Rechecked with that reasoning stated on the change, and logged the occurrence plus a narrowing datum on the flake bug.

Local rebar review-code preview of the diff: PASS, 0 blocking, 0 advisory.
